pumi.events.v1.Basis.jsonschema.json.description:
Basis lists the facts that a decision or a request relied on (decision
 0134). Each fact is a message of the fact catalog (decision 0136).

facts.description:
The facts. Each is a message of the fact catalog, which holds the fact's
 key fields and its value.

pumi.events.v1.Basis.jsonschema.json.title: Basis

pumi.events.v1.CancelRequested.jsonschem.description:
CancelRequested is the data of dev.getpumi.cancel.requested (decisions
 0035 and 0170). With a plan and no invocation it cancels the plan; with an
 invocation it cancels that invocation.

plan.description:
The plan to cancel, when the request names no invocation, or the plan of
 the invocation.

pumi.events.v1.CancelRequested.jsonschem.title: Cancel Requested
